$comment: Canonical sub-county registry. This file is the ONLY place a Nairobi
sub-county is defined — its slug, its display name, its map centroid.
Companion to pillars.json: that file answers 'what do we measure', this
one answers 'where do we measure it'. Until this existed the 17 zones
were declared twice with nothing linking them — once in
renamed in one could silently disagree with the other.
`node scripts/check-zones.mjs` fails the build if the three ever diverge.
Nothing consumes this at runtime yet. Wiring the seeder and the map to
read from it is a behaviour change and belongs in its own slice; today
it is the declaration and the drift guard is what makes it binding.
count_rationale: 17 sub-counties, matching the constituencies Nairobi County is divided into. The count is an invariant, not a coincidence: nuvola-atlas-data/pipeline/boundaries.py raises BoundaryCountError on anything other than 17, because a boundary file that silently drops one would drop a sub-county from every score.

centroid_provenance.source: hand-placed during development, carried over from ZoneSeeder.php
centroid_provenance.note: These are label anchors for map markers, NOT surveyed centroids and NOT derived from official boundaries. They are accurate enough to put a marker in the right sub-county and are not accurate enough to publish, cite, or compute area-weighted anything from. Replace them with values derived from real boundaries when those land — see nairobi-subcounties.geojson, whose polygons are placeholders too.
